name: Irene Herranz
headline: Enterprise SaaS Marketing & Sales Acceleration Executive | CMO @ Mirai RiskTech
summary:
Creative and energetic sales acceleration and marketing executive with a proven track record of leading global business expansion in high-growth SaaS environments. I specialize in long-range integrated marketing and communications planning, with strong execution across the full mix, deep sales alignment, and a focus on team building.
 
Experience highlights:
 
‣ 15+ years of GTM experience in B2B enterprise SaaS.
 
‣ 10+ years of people management, building and leading high-performing teams that balance creativity with operational rigor through hands-on mentorship.
 
‣ Multilingual professional (English, Spanish, German) with broad international experience across the US, Germany, UK, Ireland, Spain, and LATAM, spanning large corporations and startup/scaleup environments (first employee through exit, plus co-founder roles).
 
What drives me
 I'm passionate about building and executing cross-functional go-to-market plans in tight sync with client-facing teams (sales, SDRs, channel, and customer success) to drive pipeline and revenue.

positions.title: CMO / Head of Global Marketing
positions.description:
‣ As a key member of the global executive leadership team, established and led the marketing function from scratch, driving a comprehensive company rebrand and building all go-to-market channels from the ground up.

‣ Designed and launched AI-driven ABM programs that orchestrated data and actions across GTM systems, enabling automated prospecting, real-time buying signal activation, and coordinated sales and marketing engagement across priority enterprise accounts.

‣ Revamped the brand architecture and redefined the commercial portfolio for both the platform and consulting businesses, ensuring alignment with the overarching business strategy while addressing regional product-market fit.

‣ Led global sales enablement initiatives, delivering tools, resources, and training programs tailored to North America and EMEA markets, supporting consistent pipeline growth and 110% quota attainment year over year.

‣ Partnered closely with C-level executives and cross-functional teams (Sales, Product, and Customer Success) to align marketing strategies with business goals, driving increased pipeline generation and accelerated market share growth.

‣ Recruited, developed, and managed a high-performing global marketing team spanning Product Marketing, Field Marketing, Demand Generation, Event Marketing, Content, Design, Public Relations, Analyst Relations, and Marketing Operations.

‣ Managed an annual marketing budget of $500K+, with a strong focus on ABM campaigns and strategic sponsorships of key industry tradeshows, ensuring efficient allocation to maximize ROI across initiatives.

‣ Developed and executed targeted marketing campaigns, leveraging a mix of online (primarily webinars) and offline channels (primarily hosted events and industry tradeshows) to effectively reach and engage target SOM/SAM accounts.

 ‣ Managed the regional marketing budget, optimizing resource allocation and maximizing effectiveness and ROI through a continuous monitorization of campaign performance metrics and market trends.
